title: Quoted-error scaling leaves a 12.7-fold short-pair extraction contrast between GJ 191 mask eras
abstract: We audit short-pair error calibration in public GJ 191 HARPS-RVBank version 02 data. A ratio of squared velocity changes to summed quoted variances is 33.19 for DRS and 1.16 for SERVAL in 73 G2-mask pairs from 2021. In 31 earlier M2-mask pairs, the values are 2.92 and 1.29. The resulting contrast is 12.66. Signal cuts and alternative pair rules give contrasts from 3.20 to 13.57. A descriptive 30-day resample range is 4.39 to 92.67, with few earlier blocks. Mask and date have no overlap, so the result cannot identify a mask cause. It supports separate noise treatment for these records. No new planet or independent instrument confirmation is found. Original code, aggregate results, source hashes and separate-scratch retrieval steps are included. Source database records are excluded.

display.caption: Short-pair error calibration by mask era and controls. Mask and date are confounded.
